input.recommendation: Add a comprehensive .gitignore file suited for Node.js, Python, and local editor environments.

input.description: Execution of npm ci without committed package-lock.json
input.recommendation: Commit a package-lock.json manifest or use npm install when package-lock.json is not present.
input.evidence: .github/workflows/no-permissions-declared.yml line 25 runs 'npm ci', but no package-lock.json file exists in the repository.

input.evidence: .github/workflows/no-permissions-declared.yml line 26 runs 'npm test', but no package.json or test files exist in the repository, causing the job to fail on execution. (Also in .github/workflows/prt-dangerous-checkout.yml line 25).
input.description: CI test step cannot succeed as written

input.recommendation: Add explicit least-privilege permissions blocks (e.g. permissions: contents: read) at the workflow or job level across all GitHub Actions workflows.
input.evidence: Multiple workflows (.github/workflows/no-permissions-declared.yml, issue-labeler.yml, pr-comment-handler.yml, pr-title-injection.yml, prt-dangerous-checkout.yml, self-hosted-runner.yml, unpinned-actions.yml) lack explicit permissions declarations, defaulting to elevated write permissions on default repository settings.
input.description: Missing permissions block in GitHub Actions workflows

input.recommendation: Restrict permissions to only those scopes required by the job (e.g. pull-requests: write, contents: read).
input.evidence: .github/workflows/write-all-permissions.yml line 12 declares 'permissions: write-all', granting excessive write access to repository resources.

input.description: Expression injection of untrusted input in run scripts
input.recommendation: Assign untrusted expressions to environment variables and reference them using shell variable syntax (e.g., "$TITLE") to prevent command injection.

input.summary: The repository contains several critical GitHub Actions security and collaboration violations. Most workflows lack explicit 'permissions:' declarations or use 'permissions: write-all', exposing the repository to unauthorized write access. Multiple workflows are vulnerable to expression injection by interpolating untrusted 'github.event' data directly into 'run:' shell scripts. Additionally, 'pull_request_target' workflows dangerously checkout untrusted PR code and perform automated merges without human review. From a build perspective, deployments occur on every push to 'main' without automated test gates, and the CI contains demonstrably broken test steps and missing dependency lockfiles for 'npm ci'. General repository hygiene is lacking due to the absence of a '.gitignore' file and review guidance documents.
